name: [😈] MEGA IMPOSSIBLE OBBY
desc:
😈 Welcome to the MEGA IMPOSSIBLE OBBY!
Test your patience and obby skills by trying to complete a total of 200 stages, starting from easiest to almost IMPOSSIBLE!

⭐Total Stages: 200

✅ Like and favorite if you're up for the challenge!
✨ Each stage is beatable, no matter how tough it looks!
💾 Your game saves automatically, so you’re free to pause anytime!
➡️ Join our group & favorite the game for free skips! 
https://www.roblox.com/communities/5847534/DitunoStudios

Controls:
- Reset Character (R)
- Shift Lock (Shift)
- Alignment Keys ( . and , )
